guarantees.claim: tl_t_i.a_ready is driven combinational to (tl_t_o.a_valid && hfifo_reqready).

assumptions.claim: hfifo_reqready must be driven correctly from the host FIFO and reflect whether the FIFO can accept a new request.
assumptions.cond: when a TL-UL transaction is attempted
assumptions.risk: If hfifo_reqready is asserted while the host FIFO is full, tl_t_i.a_ready will wrongfully accept a request, causing data loss or overflow.

formal_sketch.antecedent: when a TL-UL transaction is attempted
formal_sketch.consequent: hfifo_reqready must be driven correctly from the host FIFO and reflect whether the FIFO can accept a new request

assumptions.claim: tl_t_o.a_valid must be asserted only when the socket is actively forwarding a request to the device.
assumptions.risk: A spuriously asserted tl_t_o.a_valid will cause tl_t_i.a_ready to be asserted, accepting a host request that may never be forwarded correctly.

formal_sketch.consequent: tl_t_o.a_valid must be asserted only when the socket is actively forwarding a request to the device

uncertain_points.claim: hfifo_reqready must be connected to the ready output of the host-side FIFO instance; misconnection could break a_ready logic.
uncertain_points.risk: If misconnected (floating, tied high/low, or wrong FIFO signal), tl_t_i.a_ready may be stuck or wrong, stalling the bus or causing data corruption.

formal_sketch.consequent: hfifo_reqready must be connected to the ready output of the host-side FIFO instance; misconnection could break a_ready logic

uncertain_points.claim: tl_t_i.a_ready is not gated by any error or clear signal; if an error condition exists, a valid request could still be accepted.
uncertain_points.cond: when an error state (e.g., protocol violation, illegal address) is present
uncertain_points.risk: Accepting a request during an error could propagate corrupt data or violate security properties.

formal_sketch.antecedent: when an error state (e.g., protocol violation, illegal address) is present
formal_sketch.consequent: tl_t_i.a_ready is not gated by any error or clear signal; if an error condition exists, a valid request could still be accepted
